SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-04: CQL — Logical Operators. Test these items: And(left, right), Implies(left, right), Not(argument), Or(left, right), Xor(left, right). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Logical Operators (And, Or, Xor, Implies, Not)
issues.evidence: Direct helpers accepted invalid operands via DuckDB truthiness: "And"(1,true)->true, "Xor"(1,false)->true, "Not"(1)->false; no-Python logicalImplies('yes','false')->true.
issues.root_cause: Direct logical macros expanded to raw DuckDB Boolean operators, and the native VARCHAR logicalImplies overload treated any non-true string as false.
issues.resolution: Guarded direct logical macros and logicalImplies Boolean-text handling; malformed direct operands now return SQL NULL across forced Python fallback, native-loaded, and no-Python C++ surfaces.
issues.verified_in: Iteration 1: cql04_skeptic_probe passed; logical parity pytest 15 passed; native CQL sqllogictest 784 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Logical Operators require Boolean operands
issues.evidence: Translated CQL accepted Code { code: 'x', system: 'urn:test' } and true and lowered it to SQL over JSON instead of rejecting a non-Boolean operand.
issues.root_cause: Static logical operand inference omitted CodeSelector, clinical instances, Quantity/temporal literals, Interval, Tuple, and parameter metadata.
issues.resolution: Extended logical operand inference for clinical/complex/static parameter shapes so known non-Boolean operands raise TranslationError before SQL generation.
